name: FarCall9FromLow
input: B=target low; C=target high bit; HL=target
behavior: selects low-caller return trampoline then enters common bridge

name: FarCall9FromHigh
input: B=target low; C=target high bit; HL=target
behavior: selects high-caller return trampoline then enters common bridge

name: FarCall9Common
behavior: saves legacy low-bank state; writes MBC5 0x2000 and 0x3000 registers; jumps HL

name: ReturnToLowBank
behavior: clears ninth ROM-bank bit before shared low-byte restore

name: ReturnToHighBank
behavior: sets ninth ROM-bank bit before shared low-byte restore

name: RestoreLowByte
behavior: restores saved FFB8 low byte and MBC5 low bank register

name: MBC5BootInit
behavior: clears ninth ROM-bank bit and jumps to original Green entry 0x0150
